book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Poldi me uŋoŋ ikiŋ yabuhohoŋe tiŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Notneye, nu koom Bepaŋdi kadakaniŋne youtetnamguk kaŋ hatitalabulatneŋ uŋaniŋ welene maaneŋ kadakaniŋ nemu hatak.”
Unduŋ yobu me Ananiya Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum adi me noli uŋgoŋ yakiŋ adi Pol maŋiŋ foloŋ utneŋ yeniŋguk.

Unduŋ yenimbu ukiŋ kaŋ Poldibo Ananiya niŋguk, “Sigige hogok walaniŋ eŋ welege maaneŋ adi geŋgeŋnit du, du Bepaŋdi gulek. Du Yodoko Mede diniŋ medi nu medene nadi tubudidimewe itaŋ iŋgoŋ Yodoko Mede lahula nunutdok yenilaŋ.”
Unduŋ niŋguk kaŋ me nolidi niŋgiŋ, “Du Bepaŋ’walaŋ Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum i maŋgoŋde unduŋ nintubukadakalaŋ?”
Unduŋ niŋgiŋ kaŋ Poldibo yeniŋguk, “Yodoko Mededi indiŋ yolak, ‘Talitimeŋhik mede kadakaniŋ mu yenindok yolak iŋgoŋ nu me i Talitimeŋ Wapum u mu nadilat doktiŋa niŋat.’”

Unduŋ yeniŋa me bop noli Sadusi eŋ noli Falisi yabuŋa kansol bop gineŋ uŋgoŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Notneye, nu batne Falisi doktiŋa nu maaŋ Falisi. Unduŋ doktiŋa nu me kumuŋa pilatneeŋ yolat doktiŋa mede gineŋ napmeiŋ.”

Sadusi heki adi me kumuŋa koti mu pilatneeŋ yoiŋ be munabuli be aŋelo nemu hatiiŋ yoiŋ, kaŋ Falisi heki adi me kumuŋa koti pilatneeŋ be munabuli eŋ aŋelo uŋgoŋ hatiiŋ yoiŋ doktiŋa me bop lufom u nehi uŋgoŋ siweneeŋ dane tigiŋ.

Unduŋ tiŋa mede wapum toŋa Falisi bop gineŋ me noli Yodoko Mede hinale hatigiŋ, ala pilali fafaŋeŋgoŋ indiŋ yogiŋ, “Me ya munabuli niŋdi bek be aŋelo niŋdi mede biyagoŋ binek niŋak. Tiŋa undugoŋ indi nemek kadakaniŋŋiŋ nemu tubumintayam.”

Unduŋ yoŋa mede gibita totubu mikme’walaŋ me wapumdi tiyaugene unduŋ totiŋa Pol fukufukuŋ hamaneu bulagine sipisipik tibaakneŋ yoŋa muntaaŋ mikme yenimbu fooŋ Pol nagila momoŋ mikme heki’walaŋ yohineŋ logiŋ.
Kaŋ timiŋ Wapumdi Pol mintamiŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Munta mu tibeŋ, fafaŋe tiŋa nutok iŋoŋ yohautalaŋ undugoŋ Loma gwaŋ maaŋ yohautawaaŋ.”
Judahidi Pol ulukumundok yohebet tigiŋ
Haniŋ Judame kunakunathik 40 kalakapmegukdi buŋa bopneeŋ nanaŋe ime kameheŋa hogok hatiŋa Pol ulukumuŋa mindaŋkade nanaŋe ime nanaŋdok yoŋa yofafaŋeeŋ yohebet tigiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ heki eŋ me wapuhi’walaŋ wooŋ yogiŋ, “Indi nanaŋe ime kamehep tiŋa hatiŋa Pol ulukumuŋa mindaŋkade nanaŋdok yoŋa kamiŋ yofafaŋe tumun.

Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi tikamanda indiŋ tineŋ, hidi kansol bop dut Pol nagi foune medeŋiŋ didimeŋgoŋ hinek nadinim yoŋa mede kameune Loma mikme’walaŋ me wapumdok lowek kaŋ nagi foune indi talipmeŋ yali ulukumunim.”
Yohebet unduŋ tagiŋ kaŋ Pol tideudi nadiŋa wooŋ mikme yohineŋ looŋ kokoŋ nimbihit tuguk.
Kaŋ kokoŋ Poldi u nadiŋa mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋ kutinimbu buune niŋguk, “Mekuya i me wapum’walaŋ mede niŋ tiŋa bulak ale nagila me wapum’walaŋ weŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbu mikme talitimeŋdi nagila wooŋ me wapum niŋguk, “Mekuya i mede niŋ ganimbe yoŋak doktiŋa Poldi kutinanimbu wene nanimbu nagi bulat.”
Unduŋ nimbu me wapumdi Pol tideu kohoŋ foloŋ honeeŋ hamaneŋ nagi wooŋ nehi hogok hinek kamekaaŋ “Nemek u nanimbu nadiwit,” niŋguk.
Kaŋ Pol tideudi yoguk, “Judame heki’walaŋ me wapuhi adi mede yofolokeneeŋ haloŋ koko’walaŋ mede nadidok yalaŋ ganimbu nagila bophik gineŋ foweŋ

kaŋ Judame yokunathik 40 kalakapmelak adi talipmeŋ hebihali ulukumuneŋ yoŋit. Adi nanaŋe ime kamehep tiŋa hatiŋa koko ulukumuŋa mindaŋkade nanaŋe ime nanaŋdok yofafaŋe tiŋit, tiŋa agaŋ tiulidokooŋ du dediŋ yobeŋdok woomgamiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa medehik mu nadiweŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbu me wapumdibo niŋguk, “Du mede i bu nanimbihitaŋ u nebek nemu nimbu nadiwek.” Unduŋ niŋa niŋkulu uguk.
Mikme hekidi Pol nagila Sisaliyade ugiŋ

Me wapum adi Pol tideu niŋkulu uune mikme diniŋ talitimeŋŋiyat lufom yenimbu buune yeniŋguk, “Hidi Sisaliyade uuŋdok mikme 2 handelet yanagitemek, agaŋ wosi foloŋ ila mik tiiŋ maaŋ 70 yanagitemek, agaŋ me bohomdi mik tiiŋ maaŋ 2 handelet yanagitemek. Unduŋ tiŋa tiulidokooŋ kamiŋ timiŋ 9 kilok tibek kaŋ uneŋ.
Tiŋa Poldok wosi niŋ miŋa baigoŋ kadokooŋ nagi wooŋ kiyap Feliks kohoŋ foloŋ kameneŋ.”
Unduŋ yeniŋa pepa indiŋ youla yembu tiŋa ugiŋ.

content.text: Nu haniŋ kedemne dutok kamegamulat, tiŋa mede indiŋ youkamulat.
Mikme hekidi me niŋ nagi wiiŋ u Judame hekidi ulukumune tigiŋ kaŋ me u Lomaniŋ nadigut
Nagila medeŋiŋ nadidok yoŋa Judahi’walaŋ kansol bop gineŋ fogumun.
Iŋgoŋ adi nemek kadakaniŋ niŋ kumuŋdegoŋ be yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ fofoŋdok nemu tuguk. Adi hogok Yodoko Medehik doktiŋa timiiŋ.
Tiŋa Judame nolidi uutdok yohebet kabukabup tiiŋ doktiŋa du’walaŋ kamewe ulak. Kaŋ me uut tine tiiŋ maaŋ agaŋ yeniŋat ala adi wooŋ gabuŋa medeŋiŋ ganimbu nadiwaaŋ. Unduŋ hogok.

content: Pepa unduŋ youla yembu tiŋa ugiŋ. Pol timiŋ nagi wooŋ Antipatili wosuwagiŋ.
Heleune mikme noli udaneeŋ bugiŋ kaŋ wosi foloŋ ugiŋ adi hogok nagi ugiŋ.
Nagi wooŋ Sisaliya wosuwaaŋ kiyap kaŋ pepa miŋa Pol maaŋ adi kohoŋ foloŋ kameeŋ bugiŋ.
Kaŋ kiyap adi pepa kunali kaŋ Pol kwet wapum deŋaniŋ ninadiguk, kaŋ Pol adi Silisiyaniŋ niluguk kaŋ niŋguk,
“Me toboniŋhi buneŋ kaŋ medege nadiwit.” Unduŋ niŋa mikme yenimbu nagila wooŋ Helotdi yoli falipmeŋ yot fafaŋeniŋ tutumbagukneŋ kameeŋ kadokogiŋ.

footnotes.text: Lisiyadi mede i yalaŋ yoguk. Mede folooŋ Poldi yoguk u Aposel 22:25-29gineŋ uŋoŋ kedem kunali nadidakaledok.
